items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jack Capp and Dave Capp. [INTERVIEWEE] Dave Capp.

ctx.x: The Caps later organized Decca, you know. Yeah. They started out in Brunswick, I guess. Jack Capp and Dave Capp.
Yeah. They still have the Capp records. Jack Capp is dead.
